editorial.blurb: Ramen-San Lincoln Park serves skillfully executed bowls with bold, deep broths and tender braised pork belly in a casual, music-filled atmosphere that keeps Chicago ramen lovers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lunch special (express lunch) for an excellent value combo with half-portion ramen, rice plate, miso salad, and edamame hummus—around $17.95—and go during off-peak hours to avoid long waits for service.
